research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document was downloaded directly (curl, browser UA) from cdn1.ocbc.id; no bot protection was met and no Internet Archive copy was needed. The document lists were read from the JSON endpoint the ocbc.id IR and governance pages themselves call (POST https://www.ocbc.id/api/sitecore/ODocuments/DocumentList). Full list with URLs in sources.md.

NAME / BRAND: the legal name is still PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (cover of the 9M2026 FS). On 14 Nov 2023 the brand name and logo changed from 'OCBC NISP' to 'OCBC' and the legal name stayed the same (AR2025 PDF p. 34 'Perubahan Nama dan Logo Perusahaan'; AR2023 PDF p. 21). That is why the website is www.ocbc.id and the logo reads OCBC.

CONSOLIDATION SCOPE: FY2019-FY2025 = the Bank + PT OCBC NISP Ventura (99.9%, operating since 2020; total assets about Rp0.25-0.4tn) + controlled mutual funds; plus PT Bank Commonwealth (PTBC) from 1 May 2024 until it merged into the Bank on 1 Sep 2024. From Aug/Sep 2026 the group also consolidates PT OCBC Sekuritas Indonesia (99.99%) and PT Great Eastern Life Indonesia (GELI; 20% owned, consolidated as financial-conglomerate holding, 80% NCI).

PTBC ACQUISITION AND MERGER: effective 1 May 2024, acquisition method (FS2024 Note 43, PDF p. 165: final fair values TA 14,497.669, loans-net 7,482.796, deposits 10,840.730, consideration 2,170.346, bargain purchase 852.946 IDR bn). The merger into the Bank on 1 Sep 2024 is a common-control transaction inside the group and changes nothing at consolidated level. The FY2023 comparatives in FS2024 were NOT restated (TA 249,757.139 in both FS2023 and FS2024), so FY2023->FY2024 growth includes PTBC: about Rp8.0tn of the Rp16.4tn gross-loan increase (FS2025 Note 12g 'Saldo dari PTBC' 8,044.274), Rp10.8tn of the Rp24.2tn deposit increase and Rp14.5tn of the Rp31.3tn asset increase. FY2024 profit includes, in non-operating income (FS2024 Note 39, PDF p. 160), the bargain-purchase gain of Rp852.9bn and merger costs of Rp589.0bn. No NISP shares were issued for the acquisition or the merger. A merger-related buyback offer to dissenting shareholders was disclosed (EGMS 2 Aug 2024). FS2024 shows unchanged issued shares and no treasury shares at 31 Dec 2024. The 9 Aug 2024 material-fact report on that offer is an image-only PDF and was not read.

2026 COMMON-CONTROL ACQUISITIONS (affects comparatives): the Bank bought PT OCBC Sekuritas Indonesia from OCBC (deed 12 Aug 2026, Rp455.2bn) and 20% of PT Great Eastern Life Indonesia from Great Eastern Life Assurance (1 Sep 2026, Rp202.0bn) (9M2026 FS PDF pp. 18-20). Under PSAK 338 the 9M2026 FS restates 1 Jan 2025, 31 Dec 2025 and 9M2025 as if they had always been combined. fy.2024 and fy.2025 store the audited figures AS ORIGINALLY REPORTED; the restated values are in each datum's note (31 Dec 2025: TA 324,888.168, equity attributable 44,834.034 incl. 977.687 'merging entities equity', total equity 45,718.914, loans 173,342.730, deposits 243,361.516). The restatement does not change the 9M2025 owners-of-the-parent profit (3,824.573 in both the original and the restated FS). Interim total assets now include GELI's insurance balance sheet (Rp17.1tn), so growth from fy.2025 total assets overstates organic growth.

PENDING: per the 9M2026 deck (p. 16) the Bank has signed an agreement with PT Bank HSBC Indonesia to acquire the assets and liabilities of HSBC's International Wealth and Premier Banking business in Indonesia. It had not completed by 30 Sep 2026.

LOANS DEFINITION: fy.*.loans_gross and the interim loans are the totals of the loans note (Note 12a 'Pinjaman yang diberikan', before allowance). They INCLUDE accrued interest income (e.g. FY2025 466.638) and sharia financing. The AR highlights print the same figures as 'Kredit yang diberikan - Bruto'. The face statement shows no subtotal without accrued interest, and none was derived.

RATIO BASIS: all FY ratios are CONSOLIDATED, as printed in the AR 'Ikhtisar Data Keuangan Penting' table: AR2025 for FY2021-FY2025, AR2024 for FY2020. Evidence: the AR's CAR of 24.53% (FY2025) and 23.60% (FY2024) equals the 'Konsolidasian' KPMM column of the Dec-2025 OJK published report (bank-only: 24.39% / 23.39%). The AR's FY2024 ROE of 13.04 differs from the bank-only 13.45. The FY analyst decks label the same values 'Rasio Keuangan Konsolidasian'. Bank-only ratios (OJK published reports) were NOT used.

RATIO RESTATEMENTS: from 2021 the LPS deposit-insurance premium moved from interest expense to operating expense, and FY2020 was restated (FY2021 deck p. 7, footnote 1). FY2020 is stored as restated: NIM 3.96 (AR2020 printed 3.80), CIR 44.1 (originally 42.3) and LDR 71.81 (AR2020: 72.03). Every other FY2020-FY2024 ratio is identical in AR2020, AR2021, AR2022, AR2023, AR2024 and AR2025. ROE is 'as reported' in the AR table. The AR does not print its denominator; profit / average total equity gives a somewhat lower figure (FY2025 about 12.0 vs 12.25 printed).

NOT DISCLOSED: cost of credit (coc) for every year, and loan-at-risk (lar) for FY2021-FY2025. Checked: the AR highlights and MD&A, and the FY analyst decks (ratio tables, asset-quality and restructuring pages). LAR exists only for FY2020 (18% incl. COVID restructuring, FY2020 deck p. 13) and 9M2026 (4.8%, 9M2026 deck p. 3). NPL coverage comes from the FY decks because the AR ratio table does not print it.
CIR: AR MD&A 'Cost-to-Income Ratio', the same as the decks' consolidated 'CTIR'. BOPO is stored separately.

DIVIDENDS: one final cash dividend for each of FY2021-FY2025. None was paid from FY2020 profit (AGMS 6 Apr 2021 kept the whole profit to strengthen capital; AR2025 dividend history: 'No dividend distributed' for 2004-2020). NISP paid no interim or special dividends. Each year's statement of changes in equity shows exactly one payment, equal to the announced final, and the FY2025 final (Rp1,032,538m) appears in the 9M2026 FS. As of the 9M2026 FS (30 Sep 2026), no interim dividend for FY2026 had been announced. Payout: 20 / 40 / 40.4 / 49.98 / 20.42 %. The FY2025 payout was cut to 20.42% in the year of the PTOS/GELI acquisitions. The FY2024 notice misprints the regular-market ex-date as '9 April 2024'; 2025-04-09 is stored.

SHARES / CORPORATE ACTIONS: issued and fully paid shares have been 22,945,296,972 at every FY end 2019-2025 and at 30 Sep 2026, unchanged since the 1:1 bonus issue (agio capitalisation) of 4 May 2018, which is before the 2019 window. There was NO split, reverse split, rights issue or bonus issue from 1 Jan 2019 to 3 Nov 2026 (share-capital history in FS2025 Note 1c/28 and 9M2026 FS; none on the agendas of the AGMS 2021-2026 or the EGMS 2024/2025), so corporate_actions is empty. The last rights issue (PUT VII) was in Nov 2013. Every year the bank bought back 0.36-0.44m shares for variable remuneration and transferred them within weeks, so there were no treasury shares at any FY end or at 30 Sep 2026. shares_out uses the issued total, which is also the EPS denominator. Of these shares, 229,520,940 founder shares are not listed on IDX (listed: 22,715,776,032). The AR market-capitalisation rows switch between the two share counts.
